summary: Rows of a sketch's Relations list that mix generated shapes with other relations delete as one exact set. With relation marks hidden, a selection of a shape's row and a relation on its geometry was removed one row at a time, so it deleted when the relation came first and was refused with dependent-sketch-element when the shape came first. The workbench now sends any selection holding a shape's row as one prepared deletion, delete-sketch-elements with every selected relation and cascade false, whatever the selection order. The relations on the deleted shape's geometry go with it, as when the shape is deleted alone. Other shapes made from what it deletes are named first in the confirmation dialog: Delete removes everything in one undo step, and Cancel keeps it all. Dependencies outside the selection that a deletion cannot take with it, such as a linear pattern seeded by a deleted member, are refused as before. Selections of relations without a shape, external reference detaches among them, still remove each relation as before.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output. The CAD document schema, the edit schema and the agent tools are unchanged; only the workbench's Relations list sends a mixed selection as one edit instead of several.

checklist.schema: No schema change. UPID, post schema, CAD documents, the edit schema, machine packages, saved revisions, storage and journals are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1, saved-job engine remains 3 and CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation, input-version or agent tool change. The Relations list's Delete sends a selection holding a generated shape's row as one delete-sketch-elements edit, prepared as Delete shape prepares it, instead of one remove-sketch-relation edit per row.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. A mixed selection of shape rows and other relations in a sketch's Relations list deletes in either selection order, naming first any other shapes made from it.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, wrapper, numbering or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Installed plugin packages, browser cache and folder adapters are unchanged.
checklist.verification: The Relations list regression with marks hidden, in both selection orders, with one Undo; the deletion domain suites; mutations of the batching; build, lint, ui:check and check-release.

publicNotes.summary: Deleting a shape together with relations selected in the Relations list works in either selection order.
changes: Selecting a shape's row and other relations in a sketch's Relations list and pressing Delete removes them together in one undo step, whichever row you selected first. When another shape is made from it, the dialog names that shape first, as when you delete the shape alone.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
